name: cascade-site
description: Cascade marketing site. Static — no build step; wrangler only uploads site/ to Cloudflare.
//: Deliberately NOT a workspace of the root monorepo (its workspaces glob is packages/*). Cloudflare Builds runs with Root directory = site, so install/deploy here must not pull in the 9 monorepo packages (Electron, VS Code extension, vitest...) to publish one HTML file.
